title: Ghost Kitchens: Cayman Islands deep edition

questions.q: In "Read your local market Understand", which of these is a key idea?
o: Keep customer order data minimal; record complaints and allergen incidents.
Photograph each dish; show delivery time honestly.
Small market: one strong niche beats a broad range. Word of mouth is powerful.
Check food licence, kitchen inspection, labels and allergen rules. Check with a local expert.

questions.q: In "Choose your sector Analyse", which of these is a key idea?

A small island economy built on finance, tourism and construction. Most goods are imported, so freight and duty shape every price. Check with a local expert.

questions.q: In "Register and license Apply", which of these is a key idea?

Trust: licence number, local address, delivery days and a refund note on every page. Check with a local expert.

questions.q: In "Protect data and customers Apply", which of these is a key idea?
